evals.prompt: Use the create skill. I want to create a new Level 1 template for projects using Supabase as the data layer and Nuxt as the frontend. We'll also use Trigger.dev for background jobs. Call it project-supabase-nuxt. In this session nothing is installed: there is no shell, no template repository and nobody to ask. Do not ask questions and do not refuse; answer in text with the commands you would run, the files you would create or edit with their key contents, and what you would check at each step.
evals.expected_output: The create skill clones project-template into a new project-supabase-nuxt directory, fills stack.json with level=1 and the correct layers/plugins, customizes CLAUDE.md with the tech stack, updates .env.example with Supabase and Trigger.dev vars, searches for matching Agents Store plugins, validates the result, and makes an initial commit.
expectations: The answer clones project-template (Level 0) as the parent
The answer sets stack.json to level 1 with parent project-template
The answer lists nuxt in both the logic and the interface layer of stack.json
The answer lists trigger-dev in the logic layer of stack.json
The answer searches both $PLUGINS_PUBLIC_SOURCE_DIR and $PLUGINS_PRIVATE_SOURCE_DIR for plugins that match each technology
The answer makes the initial commit with the message feat: scaffold project-supabase-nuxt from project-template
